entities.name: Jorn
entities.description: The Skoti god of winter, an exceptional tracker who knows the paths between realms.

entities.name: Kaldring
entities.description: Jorn's staff, called the Rimestaff, tipped with a sliver of ice from every realm he has visited.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: Jorn's brother who set out to fight every Cosmos monster.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: People whom Jorn helps when in need.

entities.name: Skaði
entities.description: Norse goddess Jorn may be based on.

entities.name: Jörð
entities.description: Norse goddess whose name Jorn's may reference.

events.summary: Alrund sets out to fight every Cosmos monster and asks only his brother Jorn for help in finding a path through the Cosmos and tracking the monsters.
events.quote: the only person he asked for help was his brother Jorn

relations.note: Brothers who share a strong bond.
